title: Who founded it, who ran it, who owns it
lede: Titles and dates come from the SEC filings and press cited. Later careers that no source covers are left out.

people.name: Todd V. Krizelman
people.text: Founded the company with Paternot in May 1995 while at Cornell.[^1][^10] The 2000 annual report describes both as former co-chief executives; together they owned 12% of the shares.[^7]

people.name: Stephan J. Paternot
people.text: The public face of the offering. Signed a new employment agreement in June 2000, a month before Peck became chief executive.[^7]

people.name: Michael S. Egan
people.text: Controlled Dancing Bear Investments, the largest shareholder, which owned about 28% of the shares in 2001.[^7][^1] Ran the company through its telephony and .travel years and bought its last business in 2008.[^11][^13]
people.later: Agreed with his companies to sell their 70.9% to Delfin Midstream in December 2017.[^14]

people.name: Charles Peck
people.text: Hired in July 2000 with options at $1.94 a share. Announced the closure of the community in August 2001.[^7][^9]
